nodes.name: Clickouts request
nodes.notes: No schedule or webhook. Default mode=preview. The sheet branch never executes deletion.

nodes.name: Read URLS from clickouts
nodes.notes: Bind Google Sheets OAuth. Pass document_id for the existing workbook (DOCUMENT_ID is intentionally not guessed). Sheet defaults to clickouts; URL column must be named URLS. This node only reads rows.

nodes.name: Preview or execute reviewed deletion
nodes.notes: Bind HTTP Header Auth: X-API-KEY for this social endpoint. No automatic retry: inspect an uncertain result before trying again. Server must independently verify ownership, exact confirmation and its execution-enable flag.
